listing.name: Faxanadu Recomp
listing.summary: Set up Faxanadu Recomp with the upstream Windows package and your matching Faxanadu original.

steps.title: Open the upstream Windows player
steps.instruction: Download the official Windows x64 ZIP from Faxanadu Recomp Releases. Extract the complete package into a separate folder and open FaxanaduRecomp.exe with its DLLs and assets alongside it.

steps.title: Select the matching USA original
steps.instruction: Choose your own USA Faxanadu ROM in the launcher. The reviewed package expects payload CRC32 57DD23D1, excluding the cartridge header. Keep your original file separately.

steps.title: Keep your progress with the player
steps.instruction: Close the game and back up its settings, mantras and saves before replacing the package yourself. Keep save states with the build that created them.

warnings: The retained USA Rev 1 input was rejected. Use a matching original with the reviewed package. This is upstream setup.

references.title: Keep optional mods separate
references.instruction: Play as Link requires your own matching Zelda II USA ROM. Seamless and Play as Link are separate experimental modes. Keep both off for ordinary Faxanadu setup.

references.title: Reviewed Windows package
references.instruction: See https://github.com/mstan/FaxanaduRecomp/releases/tag/v2.5.0 for the reviewed package, optional mod details and save-state limits.
